name: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager
short_description: A solution in Microsoft Purview that helps organizations assess and manage compliance across cloud services through assessments, regulatory templates, improvement actions and a risk-weighted compliance score.

evidence.quote: Compliance manager lives inside Microsoft purview
we can go into the compliance manager, for example, and see a lot of, you know, our compliance score
wrapped around a purview compliance manager score that hovers at 63 out of 100
Clean compliance manager shows our assessed controls mapped and scored
